verdict.rationale: Quo's homepage implies calls can be recorded and returned transcribed and summarized, and call history and voicemail transcripts can be retrieved and filtered later. Nothing in the evidence covers consent handling (announcements, per-jurisdiction rules) or retrieving the recording audio itself. Missing for 10: jurisdiction-aware recording consent handling, documented recording audio retrieval/search, explicit recording-feature docs, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a support leader, I can record calls with the consent handling my jurisdictions require and find the recordings later

citations.quote: Recorded calls come back transcribed and summarized, so no detail is missed and nobody has to take notes.
Retrieve call history and voicemail transcripts from your Quo number. Use filters to focus on what’s relevant.
